m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Excuse me? Did I invite you into my glen? I don't think so. You're going to get a cold reception.
Enough! Enough! Back off already! All this fighting is making me hot. What is it you want to know?
You want to know where that beastly She-Yeti lives? Fine. Her name is Alorna. She lives in a cave up on the ridge.
Up on the ridge? I knew I should've checked there. Thank you, Lord Groff. Maybe you're a righteous guy after all.
Well, what are we waiting for? I have been dreaming of this moment my whole life! Come on. I'll race you to the cave!
But don't you see? I understand. I've felt isolated and frustrated, just like you. We don't have to be alone any more. We've got each other.
I don't know. I'm starting to feel a little awkward here. She's got this hungry look in her eyes... I think I might need a hand.
Aw, gnarly! Not only was she unfriendly, but she was dirty too! This place is just gross. Meet me outside.
That was close. You think she really would have eaten me? Crazy. I don't even want to think about it.
You know, I always imagined that if I found another Yeti, we'd understand each other. Guess I had it all wrong.
Have to ask Lord Groff, eh? Can't say I'm too happy about that. Groff is really gruff. He's not someone I consider cool.
I suspect he won't be too friendly about this. Truth be told, I'm an explorer, not a fighter. Maybe you should go ahead and soften him up.
I'll just gather up all my gear, break down my camp, and everything, and then I'll catch up. All right? Yeah. All right.
Hope I don't come off as some kind of coward. I got no problem climbing ice cliffs, stuff like that. I just don't like confrontation.
